issues: Changed factor should specify smaller magnet F-PCB press jig, not only Test vs Normal JIG.
Outcome metric is mislabeled as result check instead of NG Frame stick Press Jig or NG rate.
Outcome domain should be quality/defect rate, not unknown.
Header row for result columns is not included in evidenceRows.

Set baselineCondition to Normal JIG and changedCondition to smaller-magnet Test JIG.
Set outcomeMetric to NG Frame stick Press Jig / NG rate.
Set outcomeDomain to process quality or defect rate.
Add Test!15 to evidence rows for the result table header.
